research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register original (47 FR 12785, PDF pages 9-10) is Executive Order 12353 of March 23, 1982, Ronald Reagan, Charitable Fund-Raising (the Combined Federal Campaign). The packet inventory had three clauses (sections 1-4 lumped, 5, 6) and omitted sections 7, 8 and 9 and the preamble; it is corrected by overrides to ten clauses: preamble and sections 1 to 9. Later instruments: EO 12404 (February 10, 1983) replaced section 1, added subsection designation (a) and new subsection (b) principles to section 2, and continued existing rules; EO 13743 (October 13, 2016) changed agencies to voluntary health and welfare organizations in the preamble and sections 2 and 3, replaced sections 1, 5 and 6, rewrote section 2(b)(5), and continued existing rules. Current law: the held U.S. Code note under 5 U.S.C. 1101 prints the order as amended by those two orders only (release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09) with sections 3, 4, 7 and 8 unchanged and section 9 revoking Executive Order 10927; other Code notes (2 U.S.C. 4524, 4557 and 4558) cite it and the eCFR search found 19 mentions (leads only). No held instrument revokes it.
